name: Utakata no Uchronia -trail-
source: This fandisc to Utakata no Uchronia includes "AFTER STORY" and "ANOTHER STORY" which depict the aftermath of the original game, as well as "IF STORY" presenting new routes for Hiiragi and Tsuwabuki. You can access any of these stories from the game's start.
translation: 这张《Utakata no Uchronia》同人光盘包括描绘原版游戏后果的“AFTER STORY”和“ANOTHER STORY”，以及介绍柊和津和吹新路线的“IF STORY”。你可以从游戏一开始就访问这些故事中的任何一个。
